reason: The 29 Sep verdict (upheld closed: needs capture and training, comes after R8, no slot) is correct, and the 'reason void' claim checks out. The old v2 verdict (research/wf_ideas_v2/r1_dedupe.json) named four cheaper division levers: cap re-tune, mirror lookup, midpoint gate and the p_edge arbiter. All four are now spent or closed. The cap dose is flat above 6 on public (ledger 56606948 0.956, 56624341 0.955, 56623073 0.955, 56611472 0.956). Mirror-daughter-lowdet was dropped in v3. Forkmid is closed. The edge filter read 0 on LB (probes 29/30). Three corrections, none of which changes the conclusion. (1) Wrong cohort label: in pairclass_out.json the cohort with parent + both daughters matched is TP 12 + FN 72, not 85. It splits into claimed 34, orphan 27, merged 9, other 2. The 85 is ALL FN of the 97 two-daughter GT divisions (72 + 3 filter-deleted + ~10 unmatched). So '40% of lab FN divisions' is right over all FN, and in the matched cohort the figure is 47%. (2) Weak ranking of the image variant: R22-RC-B shows the claimed class is mainly a relink-stage theft. 34/35 claimants are unmatched, 32/35 claiming edges are motion_relinked, and image-feature DaughterNet scores only 3/35 claimed triples >= 0.4. The image evidence at these sites is therefore weak, and an image parent-vector head is unproven. The graph/relink-stage theft-aware ranker should rank ahead of it, not merge with it as an equal. (3) 'No existing knob' should read 'no ALLOWED knob': ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT acts on the same linking, but values < 0.4 are banned by MORNING TABLE v1.1 (0.4 itself added only +3 safe forks). The lab is in-sample, so the class counts are structural and have no public or private worth for 29 Sep. Nothing here is buildable, so there is no feasibility risk.
fix: No 29 Sep action (no build, no dummy, no slot). Curator wording: '85 lab FN divisions (all two-daughter GT FN) = claimed 34 / orphan 27 / merged 9 / other 2 / filter-deleted 3 / unmatched ~10'. Post-deadline order: (a) a theft-aware relink-stage ranker on graph features for claimed daughters (R22-RC-B), with (b) the image parent-vector head as a secondary variant, justified only if graph features fail (DaughterNet image evidence scores 3/35 on these sites); then (c) the merged-daughter splitter (R32-RC-B), then (d) insert-before-short-filter (R32-RC-A). Mark DaughterNet volume (cap/thr) as plateaued on public.
